Figure 1: Overview of the 2D-ProteinRAG Framework. The workflow consists of three phases (1) Raw Homology Retrieval: The system employs BLAST to retrieve homologous sequences from UniProt. (2) Horizontal Filtering: An intent-aware filter selects relevant attribute tags based on the user’s specific instruction. (3) Vertical Filtering: The remaining descriptions are grouped via DBSCAN. The cluster consistent with the highest-similarity homolog (Structure Anchor) is retained as the valid context 𝐶.
